name: Fly through narrow gates
description: Control speed and height through the original Minus Two practice gates.

steps.text: These gates are much lower and narrower. Approach slowly, centre the opening and make small corrections. Throttle adjusts height.
steps.title: Prepare a slow approach

steps.text: Pass gate 1 without touching the frame. Slow down before the opening.
steps.title: Centre gate 1

steps.text: Pass gate 2. Keep the horizon steady and avoid a last-second throttle jump.
steps.title: Hold height through gate 2

steps.text: Pass gate 3. Prepare the approach early and keep space from the ceiling.
steps.title: Prepare gate 3 early

steps.text: Stop in a clear area and hold a gentle landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Stop and land
